scope: v5.0 regolith_rag PILOT (UI), in-game web evidence: docs/shots/ui11_rag_top.png, ui11_rag_middle.png, ui11_rag_bottom.png, ui11_rag_back_issue.png (1600x900) and my own headless shots from build/web_ui (09-29 18:24), showcase_v4, 1280x720: rag, ragscroll 700, rag 3, rag 1 (art/critic/r25/*.png, r25_grid.png). Rubric: docs/critic/v5_rubrics.md section 3.5.

regolith_rag.provisional_because: the photo is a placeholder (RENDER photo() not built) and the content is SIM stub data; the score is for the UI layout and frame.
what_works: Every section of V5 4.3 is present: red masthead THE REGOLITH RAG with issue number, day and price, the strap line 'All the dirt that is fit to print', a kicker tag, a huge lead headline, a lead photo with a caption, by-line, three smaller stories, a gossip column (The Dust-Up), Couple Watch, Feud Watch, the commander approval poll, small ads, and the Serious News strip in plain STE.
It reads as a newspaper at a glance: cream paper, bold condensed capitals, black rules, serif italic body text, a red kicker. The tabloid voice lands ('Love in the airlock', 'Answers to Wrenchy').

Integration: it sits in the V4 glass-and-metal window with a title-bar issue picker (back issues work: rag 1, rag 3 show other issues); the paper is a clean well inside the frame; names are underlined links (5 per issue).
Readable at 1600x900 and at 1280x720: headline, body and column text are clear.

ui_gaps.fix: The window covers the Alerts panel without folding it: the alert text is cut at the window edge at 1600x900 and 1280x720 (V4 rule: covered HUD panels fold). Add the Rag window to the fold rule, or open it right of the left panels.

At 1280x720 the masthead and a 3-line lead headline fill the whole first view; the photo and the stories start below the fold. Cap the lead headline at 2 lines at view heights under 800 px (auto-fit the font size 40-64 px) and shrink the masthead band by 30% there.

Paper looks flat: add a subtle newsprint texture (grain and faint fibre, 3-5% contrast), a halftone dot screen on the photo, and a thin double rule under the masthead. The page should feel printed, not a cream panel.

Empty right column: after the poll, the pull-quote 'THE RAG KNOWS.' floats over a large empty area. Let the right column carry the gossip column or a second story when the lead is short, so the page has no hole wider than 1/3 of a column.
Poll trend glyph: a red '=' beside 61% is unexplained. Use an arrow up / arrow down / dash with a word ('no change', '+4 since yesterday').
Name links need a hover state (colour and a small follow icon) and a tooltip ('Click: select. Shift-click: follow').

Layout variety: every issue uses the same template (lead + three equal columns). Add 2-3 layouts chosen by story mix (big photo lead; two-lead split; 'SPECIAL EDITION' for riots) so a back-issue flick feels like different papers.
Small ads: two boxes leave the row half empty; fill with 3-4 ads or widen them to the row.

content_gaps_not_ui.gap: Building completions dominate the smaller stories and share one template ('NEW UTILITY CABLE 16 OPENS ITS DOORS' - a cable has no doors). Rank people stories above buildings, and give buildings their own headline templates by type.
Story bodies are one line and repeat across issues ('Our spies saw them together.' on every lead). Two to four sentences per lead, drawn from the event (place, time, witnesses, a quote).
The poll shows 61% in every back issue; it should move with satisfaction day by day.
The gossip column has two lines; Couple and Feud Watch one entry each. Needs 3-5 items per box from the social log.
The lead photo is a placeholder silhouette. Needs photo() with the real people, outfits and pose (V5 4.4).

notes: PASS 0.71, provisional. The UI shell is sound; most of what holds it down is data (SIM) and the photo (RENDER).
Tone check: nothing explicit; no children in any story seen.
